locations.pageIntro: Six confirmed regions define the wider world of Leonida.

viceCity.name: Vice City
viceCity.description: The neon center of Leonida, where bright beaches, nightlife and a sprawling city create the unmistakable heart of the game’s world.

leonidaKeys.name: Leonida Keys
leonidaKeys.description: A chain of islands where Jason works around local drug runners, boat yards and the slower rhythms of the Keys.

portGellhorn.name: Port Gellhorn
portGellhorn.description: A distinct coastal region beyond Vice City, adding another side to Leonida’s varied landscape.

ambrosia.name: Ambrosia
ambrosia.description: A confirmed region of Leonida that expands the world beyond the bright center of Vice City.

grassrivers.name: Grassrivers
grassrivers.description: A rural region of Leonida that contrasts with the city and coastal environments.

mountKalaga.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
mountKalaga.description: A national park region that brings a broader natural landscape into Leonida.
